footprints.reason: Union the five administrative cities, following the same parts convention as London and Tokyo. Exclude the separately administered Thousand Islands regency, retaining rural village answers there. Do not use the broad province polygon including the sea.

boundary_evidence.reason: Territorial locality polygons own their settlement interiors regardless local city/town/village/hamlet title. Point-only weak village seats do not qualify. Either linked source anchor may validate a footprint. The alternate anchor is used only when the primary anchor is within 250 m of the boundary, preventing distant namesake links from assigning a city a tiny village footprint. Overlaps retain the source municipal precedence among accepted boundaries.
boundary_evidence.reference: Acquired Overture division_area is_territorial, subtype, linked division class and coordinates; GeoNames settlement coordinates.
